components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Form submit CTA button for checkout.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; border-radius: 24px; background: oklch(75% 0.14 165); padding: 16px 20px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid oklch(75% 0.14 165 / 30%); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px oklch(75% 0.14 165 / 25%); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(78% 0.14 165); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: oklch(72% 0.14 165); transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-text-main { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(13% 0.02 255); } .ds-btn-text-sub { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: oklch(13% 0.02 255 / 70%); margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form text input with arcade glow focus.
components.css: .ds-field-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 100%; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: oklch(78% 0.02 90); } .ds-input-text { width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(32% 0.03 255 / 70%); background: oklch(17% 0.025 255 / 60%); padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(96% 0.02 90); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input-text::placeholder { color: oklch(78% 0.02 90 / 60%); } .ds-input-text:focus { border-color: oklch(75% 0.14 165 / 60%); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 0 0 4px oklch(75% 0.14 165 / 10%); }

narrative.overview: Notable is styled with a high-energy, gamer-centric visual theme inspired by the retro-futurism of arcade cabinets and dark mode creator consoles. The interface is optimized to feel alive, responsive, and tactile. By combining deep slate backdrops with vibrant neon accents and responsive fluid typography, the design creates a feeling of presence and immediate feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Generous, rounded corner styles (40px/24px) for cards and inputs
Kinetic state transitions (hover, active, loading) that feel instant

rules.name: The Neon Rarity Rule
rules.body: Neon accents are restricted to primary interactive elements and active states. Inactive or passive surfaces must remain dark and neutral to prevent visual clutter and maintain high on-stream readability.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral shade is tinted toward the blue-grey brand hue (chroma 0.02–0.035). Pure black or pure white are strictly forbidden.

rules.name: The Title Contrast Rule
rules.body: Display and title headings must use a bold weight (600) and negative tracking to contrast sharply with the clean, airy system-ui body copy.

rules.name: The Flat Console Rule
rules.body: All cards and inputs sit flat on the grid. Depth is defined by stroke contrast and background tint changes, not by physical offset shadows.

dos: Do use OKLCH colors for all new styling declarations.
Do ensure all form controls have hover, focus-visible, and active state transitions.
Do constrain custom display fonts to headers, labels, and overlays.
Do use the synced canvas confetti burst for all overlay success confirmations.
donts: Don't use standard side-stripe borders (e.g., border-left-4) as a colored highlight on alert cards.
Don't use gradient text under any circumstances.
Don't use modals as a first resort; keep checkout and confirmation flows inline.
Don't introduce generic un-tinted neutrals (e.g., #fafafa or #121212).
Don't use decorative animations that do not correspond to a status transition or user feedback trigger.
